summary: Insight panel metadata desynchronization after retention prune removes trace-context links and skews facet counts
description: Issue summary: BrightChat reports that after a scheduled retention prune completed on 2026-03-08, the 'Insight' panel for their org shows missing trace-context links on several rows and facet counts for 'region' and 'model' are lower than expected. Impact: Customers cannot navigate from panel rows to trace timelines, automated alert links point to 404, and several dashboards show undercounted usage for the last 30 days, causing billing/visibility concerns. Environment: prod, us-east primary ingestion, org: brightchat-prod, retention policy: org-default 30d compact/7d index-prune. Observed behavior: 1) Many insight rows have 'Trace link' column blank even when raw request IDs exist. 2) Facet counts in the panel summary are ~12-20% lower versus raw events export for same window. 3) Attempting to open links returns status page event 404 or link to a pruned index shard. Expected behavior: Trace-context links should resolve to trace timelines for any non-pruned detail within retention window; facet counts in panel should match raw events export for query window. Logs/attachments: Linked ingestion logs, sample raw-event export (attached to ticket), console screenshots showing blank links and count delta.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use BrightChat org and open Insights > Custom > time range: 2026-02-09 to 2026-03-08. 2) Filter on event.type: inference.finish and model: redwood-v2-small. 3) Observe Insight panel rows: 'Trace link' column empty for ~18% of rows. 4) Export raw events for same filter and compare counts per region/model; exported counts are higher. 5) Click one of the blank trace links from UI and note 404 or 'trace not found' page.
investigation_notes: Initial triage (Aisha 2026-03-09): Confirmed customer data exists in raw event store; links generated by console appear to reference trace IDs that were removed by a pruning job.

SRE note (Diego 2026-03-10): Retention prune job ran on 2026-03-08 02:14 UTC; job used index-prune-v2 which removed secondary index shards but did not update the console's insight-link index. Suspect stale link index not reconciled after compaction.

Hypothesis (Eng 2026-03-10): Two-phase prune removes searchable trace index before updating derived link table used by console; if link-table write fails (timeout/partial), links remain but point to pruned IDs.
comments: 2026-03-09 11:05 - Aisha Khan (Support): Customer BrightChat opened with spike in 'missing trace links' after scheduled prune. Attached raw export and screenshots. Marking P1 due to enterprise contract SLA.
2026-03-09 14:22 - Diego Ramirez (SRE): Reproduced with sample org. Observed 404s for links where traceID no longer present in search index. Kicking off retention job history review.

2026-03-10 09:47 - Priya Shah (Serving Infra): Found a single retry-loop in retention worker that had a backoff setting causing link-table writes to abort after index removal. Creating patch to reorder cleanup to update link-table before shard deletion.

2026-03-11 16:32 - Diego Ramirez (SRE): Deployed temporary mitigation: delayed shard deletion window by 1 hour for affected orgs, and queued a link-table reconcile task for the last 48h. Recon task running; progress at ~65% (ETA 2h).

2026-03-12 09:00 - Customer (BrightChat - Emma Li): Noted that links are starting to return for older rows; Facet counts still low for model 'redwood-v2-small'. Requested confirmation when full reconciliation completes.

2026-03-12 12:10 - Aisha Khan (Support): Informed customer we are reconciling metadata and will provide follow-up when reconcile completes. Keeping ticket open until counts match exports and link failures are resolved.
next_steps: Finish link-table reconcile for 48h window and verify counts against raw export (Diego/SRE).
Merge retention-service patch to reorder writes so that link metadata is updated before shard deletion (Priya/Eng) - PR referenced above.
Add a short-term guard to retention job to postpone shard deletion if link-table write failures detected (SRE/ENG).
Run a full audit for orgs that had prune between 2026-03-07 and 2026-03-09 and notify any affected customers (CS).
